name: JSON Minifier
summary: Minify JSON by removing whitespace — validate and shrink locally in your browser.
description: Paste pretty-printed JSON and get a compact single-line result. Invalid JSON shows a clear error. Pair with JSON Formatter when you need to beautify again.

faqs.question: Does minifying change values?
faqs.answer: No. It parses then re-serializes with JSON.stringify, so structure and values stay the same — only whitespace is removed.

faqs.question: What about trailing commas?
faqs.answer: Standard JSON does not allow trailing commas. Fix them first (or use JSON Validator for hints).

faqs.question: Is my JSON uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Minification runs entirely in your browser.
